chain_words.nuance: to acknowledge that something exists or is valid
to admit that a claim or situation is true
to agree to receive or take something
to give public support to a position
to approve an agreement formally so that it becomes binding

explanation: These words all describe agreeing to something, from recognizing its existence to formally making an agreement binding.

usage_notes.difference: 'Endorse' means giving public support to a position; 'ratify' means formally approving an agreement so that it becomes legally binding.
